    SELECT DISTINCT 
        session, 
        stamp, 
        option, 
        path,
        search_type

),
with_rn AS (
    SELECT *,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY session ORDER BY stamp, option, path) as rn

FROM with_rn
ORDER BY session, rn
LIMIT 100 OFFSET 50
